name: s01_basic_crossing
title: Basic crossing at the same level
description: Two flights at FL350 on crossing routes, plus an overflight at FL370.
design_notes: RAM201 and AFR452 reach the centre crossing point at the same second (t=660). Classic solution: one level change (e.g. AFR452 FL340 or FL360 - NOT 370, DLH82 is there) or a heading for one of them. Passive => loss of separation.
